sections.heading: 1. Who provides the service and acceptance of the terms
sections.body: The TruckSOS service (the Android/iOS application and https://trucksos.net) is provided by Breană David Eduard, natural person, Romania, support@trucksos.net. By creating an account or using the service you accept these terms and the Privacy policy (which forms part of them). If you do not agree, do not use the service. When you sign up you confirm your acceptance and that you are at least 18 years old; for a new version of the terms we will ask you to confirm again.

sections.heading: 2. What TruckSOS is
sections.body: TruckSOS connects truck drivers whose vehicles have broken down with available mechanics. The application only facilitates contact: the price, the carrying out of the work and the payment are agreed directly between the driver and the mechanic. Price offers in applications are indicative and non-binding until the parties reach a direct agreement. TruckSOS is not a party to the contract between them, does not guarantee the availability, quality or price of the work, and does not charge any commission. The Market section allows users to publish sale listings for parts, tyres, trucks and trailers. Negotiation, payment and delivery take place directly between buyer and seller, outside the application; TruckSOS does not process payments, does not verify products and does not guarantee the transaction. The community channel is a public space for discussion between users; messages are visible to everyone, including visitors without an account.

sections.heading: 3. Who may use the service
sections.body: The service is intended for professionals in road transport and car service workshops, and is reserved for persons aged at least 18. One account corresponds to one person or company; you create your account with real details, use it personally, and are responsible for keeping your sign-in details safe and for everything that happens in your account. Visitors without an account can view public content (mechanics’ profiles, active listings, the channel), without writing or contacting anyone.

sections.heading: 4. Your content
sections.body: You remain the owner of the content you publish (breakdown announcements, Market listings, photos, videos, files, messages, ratings). You grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence, limited to storing, displaying and transmitting it within the service (including in push notifications and, at another user’s request, automatic translation of listings), for as long as the content exists in the application. You guarantee that you have the right to publish the photos and files (do not publish photos of other people without their consent) and that you do not include in listings or messages personal data of third parties (telephone numbers, documents) without their consent. The following are prohibited: illegal, misleading, threatening, offensive or discriminatory content; false or duplicate listings; spam and unsolicited advertising; using the service to collect data about other users; circumventing technical measures (rate limits, blocks).

sections.heading: 5. Conduct, moderation and reports (Digital Services Regulation — DSA)
sections.body:
• You can report content or users from the application and you can block any user. Anyone, including without an account, can send a report to abuse@trucksos.net or at https://trucksos.net/report, stating the content, the reason and a contact address.
• We confirm receipt of the report and decide within 48 hours for manifestly illegal content, respectively within 7 days in other cases. Possible measures: removal of the content, restriction of visibility, temporary or permanent suspension of the account. The author of the content receives the reasons for the decision (in the application and by notification) and can contest it within 14 days at abuse@trucksos.net; we reply to the contestation within 14 days at the latest. Reports that are manifestly unfounded or repeatedly abusive may lead to their being temporarily disregarded.
• Moderation is reactive (based on reports); we do not monitor private conversations. Administrators’ access to messages is limited and logged, as described in the Privacy policy.
• The languages in which we receive and reply to reports are Romanian, English and German.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: Version 1.1.0 · in force from the release date of version 1.1.0 of the app

sections.heading: 1. Who we are (the operator)
sections.body:
TruckSOS is a mobile and web application that connects truck drivers whose vehicles have broken down with available mechanics. It also includes a section for sale listings (Market) between users and a public community discussion channel.

The controller of personal data is Breană David Eduard, natural person, Romania, e-mail support@trucksos.net. We have not appointed a data protection officer; any request about your data should be sent to the address above.

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
sections.body:
• Account data: e-mail address and password (the password is stored encrypted by the authentication provider, Supabase; we never see it). When you sign in with Google or Apple we receive only your e-mail address (or the Apple relay address, if you choose “Hide My Email”) and your name; we do not receive your Google or Apple account password. If you sign in with Apple from the iOS app, we keep an encrypted technical token issued by Apple, used exclusively to revoke the authorisation at Apple when you delete your account (an Apple requirement); we do not use it for any other purpose.
• Profile data: name, role (driver / mechanic), profile photo, language; for mechanics: specialisation, area of activity, company, address, VAT number, contact e-mail; telephone number (both roles); approximate GPS position, if you set one for distances.
• Reports without an account (the trucksos.net/report page): the e-mail address you provide and the content of the report, used only to handle it and reply to you (see §7); no account is needed.
• Content: breakdown announcements (description, location, coordinates, truck make and model, registration number and chassis number — data you provide yourself), saved trucks, mechanics’ applications (optional price offer, message), Market listings (title, description, price, photos), private and channel messages (text, photos, videos with their sound — recorded from the conversation, in which case the microphone is used only while you are recording, or picked from your gallery —, files, including audio files), ratings, favourites, blocks, history of mechanic searches.
• Technical data: the device’s push notification token (platform, app version), the time of the last reading of conversations / channel, notification preferences, the connection diagnostic log (time, type of network error, app version — without message content; it is uploaded only after you sign in), the app error reports you choose to send from the “Something went wrong” screen (the error type and its technical details — the error message and stack trace, from which e-mail addresses, phone numbers and identifiers are removed automatically —, the screen, the platform, the app and operating system version and a short code derived from your account, used only to count how many users are affected; no e-mail, phone or message content; deleted after 30 days).
• Local storage on the device / in the browser: authentication session (encrypted on the phone), preferences (language, theme, filters), messages not yet sent (local queue), photo cache. On the web we use only the storage strictly necessary for operation; we do not use tracking or advertising cookies, which is why we do not show a cookie banner. The web map loads Google Maps when you open the map screen (Google may set its own cookies; see Google’s policy).

sections.heading: 3. Who sees what
sections.body:
• Telephone number: NOT public. It is seen only by the user with whom you have an open conversation (after an accepted application or a conversation you started).
• Registration number, chassis number and exact position of a breakdown announcement: seen only by you, the accepted mechanic and administrators. Other mechanics see the announcement with the position rounded to approximately 1 km and without the plate or chassis number.
• Name, photo, company, specialisation, area, ratings: visible to signed-in users and, for mechanics, to visitors without an account (public service provider profile). The mechanics’ address and VAT number are shown in the public profile, as information of a service provider.
• Visitors without an account (guests) can see: the list of mechanics (public profile), active Market listings, open breakdown announcements (without plate or chassis number, with approximate position, with the author’s name) and messages in the public community channel, but they cannot write, contact anyone or see contact data.
• Private messages are visible only to their participants; channel messages are visible to all users and visitors.
• Push notifications may contain the title and an excerpt of a message or listing; they pass through the services of Expo, Google (Android) and Apple (iOS) — see §5.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes and legal bases
sections.body:
• Providing the service (account, announcements, applications, chat, Market, notifications): performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
• Safety, moderation, prevention of abuse, rate limits, the diagnostic log, the error reports you send: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) — to keep a functional and safe service for professionals.
• Legal obligations (DSA reports, requests from authorities, record of moderation actions): legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
• Optional notifications (new Market listings, mentions) and location: consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time in Settings.

sections.heading: 5. Where the data is and who processes it for us
sections.body:
The data is stored on Supabase infrastructure in the European Union (Ireland, AWS eu-west-1). We use the following processors (sub-processors); for providers outside the European Economic Area, the transfer is based on the EU–US adequacy decision (Data Privacy Framework, DPF) and/or on the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC):

Supabase Inc. (on AWS): database, authentication, file storage, server functions: EU (Ireland): within the EEA
Brevo (Sendinblue SAS): account e-mails (confirmation, password, change of e-mail): EU (France): within the EEA
Expo (650 Industries Inc.): delivery of push notifications to the device: USA: SCC
Google LLC / Google Ireland Ltd.: maps (Android, web), sign-in with Google (optional), push delivery on Android (Firebase Cloud Messaging), on-request translation of listings (Cloud Translation): USA / Ireland: DPF + SCC
Apple Inc.: sign-in with Apple (optional), push delivery on iOS (APNs), maps on iOS: USA: DPF
Cloudflare Inc.: hosting of the web application (trucksos.net), bot protection (Turnstile) at sign-up and for reports: USA (global network): DPF
GitHub Inc. (Microsoft): hosting of the mirror of the legal pages: USA: DPF

We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for their own purposes. Translation of listings sends only the text of the description to Google, at the request of the reader.

sections.heading: 6. How long we keep the data
sections.body:
Account, profile, content: as long as the account is active
Registration number, chassis number, exact coordinates of a closed (resolved / cancelled) breakdown announcement: deleted automatically 90 days after closing; the text of the announcement remains in your history
Unpublished listing drafts: 24 hours
Open breakdown announcements: become “cancelled” after 30 hours without acceptance (their photos are deleted)
Who opened an announcement (views, administrators only): 90 days
Private conversations with no new message: 24 months, then complete deletion with attachments
Closed reports (with a copy of the reported message and, for reports without an account, the reporter’s e-mail): 12 months; open reports, until resolved
Log of administrative actions: 12 months (no personal data in clear text)
Push notifications in the queue: 48 hours (content is deleted immediately after sending)
Connection diagnostic log: 90 days
App error reports (sent by you): 30 days
Apple token for revocation: until the account is deleted
Log of acceptance of the terms (date, version): 3 years from acceptance (also after account deletion; technical identifier, version and date only)

Deleting the account: from the app (Profile → Settings → Delete account) or by e-mail. It is immediate and irreversible: your profile, announcements, trucks, applications, ratings, favourites, photos and files are deleted; if you signed in with Apple, we revoke the authorisation at Apple. The following remain, pseudonymised (no name, no contact details, marked “deleted user”): the text messages you sent in other people’s conversations and in the channel (so that others keep their conversations), ratings received by mechanics (the average remains), and — without personal data — the moderation / report log where the law requires it. Details: the page “Delete account”.

sections.heading: 7. Moderation, reports and administrative access (DSA)
sections.body:
• You can report content or users from the app and you can block any user. Anyone (including without an account) can send a report to abuse@trucksos.net or through the form at https://trucksos.net/report. We confirm receipt and decide within 48 hours for manifestly illegal content, respectively 7 days otherwise; the author of the content receives a notice with the reasons for the decision (in the app, in the section “Moderation notices”, and by push) and can contest it within 14 days at the same address. Possible actions: removal of the content, temporary or permanent suspension of the account.
• Administrators do NOT have general access to private conversations: they can only see a limited window of messages around a reported message or, in a report against a user, the latest messages between the reporter and the reported user. Each access is recorded in the administrative log. Administrator accounts use two-step authentication.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
sections.body: Access, rectification (directly in the app), erasure (from the app), restriction, objection, portability (“Download my data” in Settings gives you a file with your account data and the content you created, twice a day; without the technical logs — the connection diagnostic log and the error reports), withdrawal of consent (the switches in Settings). We reply within 30 days at the latest to support@trucksos.net. You can lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority — in Romania, ANSPDCP (the Romanian supervisory authority, www.dataprotection.ro) — or with the authority in your country.

sections.heading: 9. Who the service is for
sections.body: TruckSOS is intended for professionals in road transport and service workshops. The service is reserved for persons aged at least 18; you confirm this when you sign up. We do not knowingly process data of minors; if we learn of such an account, we delete it.

sections.heading: 10. Security
sections.body: Encrypted connections (TLS), passwords managed by the authentication provider, session stored encrypted on the phone, access to data based on row-level security rules (RLS), the Apple token encrypted in the database, administrators with two-step authentication. No method is absolutely secure; if an incident affecting you occurs, we will inform you as required by law.

sections.heading: 11. Changes
sections.body: We may update this policy. For important changes we will ask you to confirm it again the next time you open the app; the version and date are shown above. Previous versions are available on request.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
sections.body: Breană David Eduard, natural person, Romania, support@trucksos.net · reports: abuse@trucksos.net · https://trucksos.net/legal
